research.facts:
Verstappen Exit Clause
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Verstappen's Red Bull contract runs through 2028 and contains performance-based exit clauses (ESPN, GPFans, RacingNews365 confirmed)
- Exit clause threshold: must finish outside top 2 in championship by summer break in August (Crash.net, ESPN)
- Verstappen is 7th in the championship after 11 rounds — well outside top 2; clause fully active (F1-fansite.com, GridGuy.racing)
- Verstappen's manager Raymond Vermeulen publicly admitted the exit clause is active for the first time (TheJudge13, July 16)
- Red Bull attempted to buy out the exit clause in June 2026 — Verstappen REFUSED (SportBible, July 7)
- October deadline to trigger the exit clause (multiple confirmed sources)
- McLaren speculation: Zak Brown denied wanting to change line-up but said Verstappen would be good "should one of my drivers slip on a banana peel" (ESPN)
- Verstappen refused to commit to staying at Red Bull past 2026 (ESPN, TSN)
- Toto Wolff took up George Russell's option year (door to Mercedes closed)
- F1 Championship standings after 11 rounds (Hungary): Antonelli 219pts / Hamilton 169pts (+50 gap) / Russell 160pts; 291 points remaining; Norris won Hungary
**MEDIUM confidence:**
- McLaren in "closing stages" of Verstappen talks per SportBible (July 7) — denied by McLaren sources to ESPN

research.facts:
Aston Martin / Honda Upgrade
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Aston Martin debuted AMR26 B-spec at Hungarian GP: 16-part chassis upgrade package (The Race, Autosport, Motorsport Week confirmed)
- Alonso qualified into Q2 at Hungary for first time all 2026 season (multiple sources)
- Honda conducting filming day at Zandvoort ahead of Dutch GP to debut upgraded PU (Autosport, July 29)
- Honda's upgraded power unit estimated at up to 30bhp gain (GPFans, Autosport — single reporting, medium-high confidence)
- Honda PU upgrade debuting at Dutch GP, Round 12 (Autosport confirmed)
- Further chassis updates planned at Zandvoort, Monza, and Baku (Autosport, GPFans)
- Alonso's contract expires end of 2026; retirement decision expected after summer break (GPFans, Autosport confirmed)
- Aston Martin had 1 point entering Hungary (Alonso's Monaco result); Cadillac outpacing them in first season (F1ingenerale)
**MEDIUM confidence:**
- Exact bhp figure (30bhp) from single source — power unit estimates are inherently uncertain

research.facts:
F1 Calendar Crisis
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Bahrain Grand Prix (originally March) cancelled due to Iran-US/Israel conflict in Middle East (multiple sources confirmed)
- Saudi Arabian Grand Prix (originally March) cancelled for same reason
- Qatar GP (Nov 27-29) and Abu Dhabi GP (Dec 4-6) at significant risk (RacingNews365, Sky Sports, Sportbible confirmed)
- Domenicali confirmed "mid-September" deadline to make Qatar/Abu Dhabi decision (AOL, Sunday Guardian confirmed)
- Contingency plan confirmed by F1: season will end in Europe if Middle East races cancelled (Sky Sports confirmed)
- Imola is among circuits being considered as replacement (TheJudge13, F1 CEO confirmed)
**MEDIUM confidence:**
- One source (SportscapeMagazine) reports Qatar + Abu Dhabi already cancelled, Las Vegas = season finale — not confirmed by multiple major outlets
